'''Kibi''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vorzyd IV]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Threat Within" /> In [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]],<ref name="Essential Readers">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] traveled to Vorzyd IV on as part of an [[Mission to Vorzyd IV|investigation]]. One morning, the world's [[Vorzydiak]] [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]], [[Port]], left a meal of cold Kibi and [[patot panak]] at his dwelling for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who dutifully ate it. Though Kenobi did not think the food looked appetizing.<ref name="Threat Within" />  

The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] offered a [[Vorzyd slider/Legends|Vorzyd slider]] at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The slider's patty was topped with sautéed [[Vorzydiak mushroom]] and three [[Kibi strip/Legends|kibi strips]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kibi first appeared in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Threat Within]]'', the eighteenth book in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'' junior novel series. The book was written by [[Jude Watson]] and published in [[2002]].<ref name="Threat Within" />
